verification.notes: Unsealed court materials support that Lively involved Swift in efforts to bolster script revisions and that Baldoni described feeling pressured. records.text: Candace Owens said Taylor Swift's messages showed that Swift called Justin Baldoni a derogatory name and knew Blake Lively planned to file a sexual-harassment complaint to obtain publishing rights and control of the movie.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But now her messages are out and it turns out that Taylor Swift ... called Justin Baldoni a B-I-T-C-H with a tiny violin and she knew that Blake Lively was going to file that sexual harassment complaint to get these publishing rights,

verification.notes: Unsealed texts confirm Swift used the derogatory term and a 'tiny violin' reference. Other messages shortly before Lively filed her complaint suggest awareness that something was coming, but they do not establish that Swift knew the complaint was intended to obtain publishing rights or control of the film. The first portion is confirmed; the claimed purpose and knowledge are not.
